traffic: Old router labels (17+233*i) mod3750 for i0..15. All240 distinct ordered pairs. Each source injects1 total, split1/15 per target. No new router is a traffic endpoint.
routing: Uniform over every complete shortest path for each demand, using integer BFS shortest-path counts and reverse dependency accumulation; not locally uniform next-hop ECMP.
link_model: Full duplex, capacity1 separately in each directed arc. Static fluid loads, no queues or real throughput measurement.

predictions.hops: Old-old shortest distances and therefore average hops exactly unchanged by complete-open-neighborhood false-twin additions.
predictions.port_slots: Endpoint slots equal r*n-2m; net slot change per new degree20 clone is r-40, so r24/32 lose slots, r48 gain slots.
predictions.load: Expect directed peak load not to increase under this fixed equal-shortest-path workload; this is falsifiable, not a mathematical monotonicity claim.
predictions.new_edges: Expect positive traffic using new edges, without claiming workload represents all routers.

traffic_fraction_definitions: Probability mass whose selected shortest path uses at least one new edge
New-edge hop-volume divided by total directed hop-volume
faults_wiring_and_additional_metrics: Not measured; no additional platform, no further engineering batch after completion.
